title: 拒绝空输入并限制权限
premise: 制品读取恢复，清理仍停用，开始修复危险输入与访问边界。
listeningTask: 理解输入检查、目录范围和最小权限各自的作用。

lines.en: The guard clause rejects missing tenant values. An empty path component now fails closed.
lines.zh: 保护分支拒绝缺失的租户值，空路径项现在会直接拒绝执行。

lines.en: That protects inputs, not every filesystem race. Use constrained directory handles for deletion too.
lines.zh: 这保护输入，不解决所有文件系统竞态；删除还要用受约束的目录句柄。

lines.en: I'll narrow the identity to tenant storage. Shared artifact directories won't grant deletion rights.
lines.zh: 我把身份权限收敛到租户存储，共享制品目录不授予删除权限。

lines.en: Just to confirm, links are rejected, right? We're not silently following external targets.
lines.zh: 确认一下，链接会被拒绝，对吧？不能悄悄跟随外部目标。

lines.en: Yes, and replacement races need explicit tests. A static path check isn't enough.
lines.zh: 是，并发替换竞态要专门测试，静态路径检查不够。

lines.en: I'm on it with the handle-based implementation. Maybe we'll need a platform-specific helper.
lines.zh: 目录句柄实现我来做，可能需要平台专用辅助函数。

lines.en: Review that helper before production use. Unsupported platforms must refuse deletion rather than fallback.
lines.zh: 生产使用前审查辅助函数，不支持的平台拒绝删除，不能降级到不安全实现。

lines.en: Okay, make that an explicit action item. Hannah owns verification, Raj owns the implementation.
lines.zh: 好，列成明确行动项，Hannah负责验证，Raj负责实现。

lines.en: I'll preserve the evidence alongside test results. Reviewers can trace each protection to failure.
lines.zh: 我会把证据与测试结果一起保留，让评审能对应保护与故障。

lines.en: Good, cleanup permissions stay suspended for now. Code approval alone won't unlock production access.
lines.zh: 好，清理权限暂时继续停用，代码通过不代表生产权限自动恢复。

scene: 制品读取恢复，清理仍停用，开始修复危险输入与访问边界。
